Name: Monster Spawner (Debug)
Author: Malacay2k11
Description:
[left]Monster Spawner is a debug and testing tool that lets you spawn any monster in the game on demand, right next to your character. Press F5 to open a spanwer menu! Choose a Monster and spawn it instantly!

[size=4][b]Good to know:
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Slime+ Drops only works within Mines (Loot Table are bound by Depth)[/size][/*]
[/list][/left]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it into your "Stardew Valles / Mods" Folder[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Press [b][i][color=#00ff00]F5[/color][/i][/b] (by default) in-game to open the Monster Spawner menu.[/*]
[*]Browse a full grid of monster types, pick one, and click [color=#00ff00][b]SPAWN [/b][/color]to place it next to your character.[/*]
[*][b][i][color=#00ff00]Variants[/color][/i][/b]: many monsters (Bat, Slime, Ghost, RockCrab, Serpent, Skeleton, and more)[/*]
[*][b][i][color=#00ff00]Live preview[/color][/i][/b]: See the exact sprite, color, and name of your selection before you spawn it.[/*]
[*][b][i][color=#00ff00]Color picker[/color][/i][/b]: Monsters with a recolorable sprite let you pick a custom tint.[/*]
[*][b][i][color=#00ff00]Spawn multiplier[/color][/i][/b]: Spawn x1, x10, or x25 monsters at once with a single click.[/*]
[*]The game pauses automatically while the menu is open (single-player), so you can browse and spawn without being attacked.[/*]
[*]Fully translated UI: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Chinese (Attention: Translated by AI)[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/color]
